questions.qtext: Which one of the following statement(s) is/are INCORRECT?

options.text: Degeneracy in an LPP may arise at the initial stage.
A degenerate solution can never be optimum.
For solving an LPP by simplex method, it is essential that all variables involved are nonnegative.

questions.solution:
(b)
• Degeneracy in an LPP may arise at the initial stage, and at any subsequent interation stage.
• A degenerate solution may or may not be optimum.
